notes.title: 🧹 One Man’s Trash - Game Modes Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"]🚨 Spoiler Warning:

This post reveals gameplay systems, item mechanics, and late-game content. Prefer to discover things yourself? Now’s the time to stop scrolling.
[hr][/hr]🎮 New Difficulty Modes


🛋 Cozy Mode
A relaxed experience:
• No enemies
• Coupons never expire — use them anytime
• Perfect for chill diggers and explorers



🧹 Classic Mode (Default)
The tried-and-true setup:
• Enemies spawn deep underground
• Coupons expire shortly after pickup
• Balanced and faithful to the core experience



🕳 Abyss Mode
For the brave (or foolish):
• No central rope — escape is up to you
• Enemies hit harder
• Coupons can be stored like in Cozy
• A true descent into madness
[hr][/hr]🐛 Pet Worm Overhaul
Your loyal worm now consumes trash from your vacuum’s dustbag.
[hr][/hr]🏆 New Achievement
💀 No Way Up
Complete a full run in Abyss Mode.
Only the toughest (or most stubborn) diggers will make it out alive.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
• Minor bug fixes
[hr][/hr]
Dig deep. Stay sharp. Feed the worm.
[hr][/hr]
Tag us on socials or join the community: 
👉 Join the Discord – share finds, bugs, screenshots, memes, and your wildest holes.

Jony Pazu
Solo Dev

notes.title: 🎮 One Man's Trash - Hotfix 1.3.2 Released!
notes.content:
🛠️ Hotfix 1.3.2 Patch Notes
Fixed incorrect resolution display when using fullscreen mode

Bloom and motion blur effects have been adjusted and fixed

Achievements now track and unlock properly

Added a “Skip Intro” toggle in the Settings menu

Improved controller sensitivity for more responsive movement

Fixed bug causing incorrect FPS to be displayed

💡 Note: Controller and Steam Deck support are not officially supported yet, but they should work for most players. We’re keeping an eye on compatibility, so feel free to report any issues!

Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 🚀 One Man’s Trash is OUT NOW! Vacuum, Dig, Profit.
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"]🧹 It's Time. Let's Suck.
One Man’s Trash is now officially released on Steam!
Grab your vacuum. The junkyard is yours.
[hr][/hr]💡 What Is This Game?
A true story meets a fever dream:
You’re a washed-up crypto bro who just blew his last cash on a sketchy junkyard.
Why? To dig for a lost hard drive containing 8,000 PitCoin. That’s over $100 million.

Armed with a janky vacuum, your only choice is down.
[hr][/hr]🌀 Suck. Sell. Upgrade. Go Deeper.
📺 Find cursed items, pop culture relics, and tons of trash.
💎 Unlock vacuum skins, earn achievements, and master the pit.
👁️‍🗨️ Something is lurking deep below. You’ve been warned.
[hr][/hr]🛠 What's in the Launch Version?
Here’s just some of what’s waiting for you:

💻 Full upgrade system (vacuum power, size, rope length, inventory, tools)

🗑 60+ collectible items across 3 tiers: Trash, Rare, and Secret Locations

🎰 Three in-game websites: Junkbay, Junkazon, Junkasino

🧭 Discover hidden locations

🎮 Controller support + customizable keyboard mapping

📦 Trophy pedestals and achievement tracking

🧟‍♂ Enemies and hazards deeper down (don’t ask)

🧹 Vacuum skins to unlock

🎯 One ultimate goal: Find the drive.
(If it even exists…)
[hr][/hr]🗣 We Want to See Your Trash
Please share your:

🤯 Best vacuum builds
😂 Funniest screenshots
🐛 Bug reports (yes please)
😱 Ridiculous pit escapes
💀 Horrible deaths by falling or… other things

Tag us on socials or join the community:
👉 Join the Discord – share finds, bugs, screenshots, memes, and your wildest holes.
[hr][/hr]🧡 Thank You
This game was built entirely solo over months of vacuum-induced madness.
Huge thanks to everyone who played the demo, gave feedback, wishlisted, or shared it online.

You made this possible.
Let’s dig.

Jony Pazu
Solo Dev, Vacuum Enthusiast

notes.title: 🧹 Steam Update: Full Game Feature Reveal + Join the Discord!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"]🚨 Spoiler Warning:
This post contains a full breakdown of all core gameplay systems, upgrades, item types, and end-game goals. If you're someone who likes to discover everything on your own  feel free to stop scrolling now and go dig.

For everyone else: here's exactly what awaits you in One Man’s Trash.
[hr][/hr]Also: Join the official JONY PAZU GAMES Discord:
👉 https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG

Why Join?

• Share your weirdest vacuum builds
• Post your best finds & cursed screenshots
• Report bugs
• And yes, show us your messed-up pits
[hr][/hr]🗑 ONE MANS TRASH – Complete Feature List🔧 Core Gameplay
• Vacuum Tool: Suck up trash and materials to dig deeper
• Rope System: Climb back up with a central rope
• Progressive Digging: Dig your own way in an endless pit
[hr][/hr]💻 Laptop Hub (3 Websites)
• Junkbay: Sell your junk
• Junkazon: Buy upgrades, tools, and utilities
• Junkasino: Gamble your savings (it’s probably a bad idea)
[hr][/hr]🔼 Upgrade System
• Vacuum Strength: More suction
• Vacuum Size: Bigger area
• Vacuum Capacity: Carry more per trip
• Inventory Space: Bigger bag = better haul
• Rope Length: Go deeper
• One-Time Tools: Lamps & scanners
[hr][/hr]🗑 Collectibles (62 Total)
• Normal Trash (30): Cones, toilets, cardboard boxes, etc.
• Rare Items (20): High-value collectibles (Einstein’s Brain, Moon pebble, and more)
• Locations (12): Hidden spaces like trains, cars, mine shafts, even a spaceship

• Special Items:

   o Double jump
   o Shop discount timer
   o Other surprises
[hr][/hr]🌍 World & Secrets
• Surface Junkyard: Full of stuff to vacuum
• Underground World: More loot, more risk
• Mine System: With TNT traps and... strange sounds
• Deep Spaceship: Includes a teleporter
[hr][/hr]📦 Collection & Progression
• 3 Trophy Containers: Track trash, rares, and locations
• Pedestals: Display the cool stuff you found
• Unlock Skins: For your vacuum
• Achievements: 25 to complete
[hr][/hr]☠ Enemies & Hazards
• Worms: They’re real. They’re fast. They’re angry.
• TNT Traps: Use them wisely
[hr][/hr]🎯 Main Goal
• Find the Lost Hard Drive
It holds 7,000 PitCoin. It’s worth millions. It’s probably real. Maybe.
[hr][/hr]🧃 That’s the Game.
A trash-filled descent. An addictive core loop. Secrets, satire, and suction.

👉 Join the Discord and let us know what you find.
👉 And if you haven’t yet – wishlist the game to support the launch on July 23!

Stay trashy,
– Jony Pazu 🧹

notes.title: 🚧 One Man’s Trash – Public Demo Updated & July Release Incoming!
notes.content:
Big things are happening in the junkyard! The public demo of One Man’s Trash just received a major update – with more to explore, new systems to uncover, and your first glimpse of what’s coming in the full game.
📆 Full release planned for July 2025
 🧡 Wishlist now to support the launch and stay in the loop!

🔧 What’s New in the Demo:
🗂️ Collection System
 Rare items now glow and can be displayed in your Trophy Room. Discover hidden locations and build your collection!
🔒 Locked Vitrines
 Find and unlock special vacuum skins by completing item and location sets.
📻 Radio System
 You can now turn on the radio and switch between multiple music tracks – or turn it off if you prefer the silence.

🛠️ Plus:

 Rebalanced item values & upgrade costs
 Improved overheating mechanics
 Carry two special items instead of one
 Added credits page
 Tons of bug fixes and polish


Whether you're returning to the junkyard or diving in for the first time: now’s the perfect time to experience the updated demo – and get hyped for the full game in July!
👉 Add One Man’s Trash to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release!
